The minimum-cost plan I found rescues 11 people and defers 2 adults from Likhu village, for a total cost of 191. I worked this out by comparing the options by hand rather than with a solver.

**Nilkantha farm (car1):** A round trip from Benighat takes 44 minutes and carries all 3 people (2 injured, 1 adult). Deferring the 2 injured people would cost 160, so this trip is clearly worthwhile.

**Likhu village and Kalika temple (car2):** There are 10 people here (4 injured, 4 adults, 2 elderly). Kalika temple is not an evacuation point, so everyone must go to Dhunche hospital.

| Option for car2 | Driving | Penalties | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rescue all 10 (Likhu twice at 44 each, Kalika once at 60) | 148 | 0 | 148 |
| **Two trips, defer 2 adults (Likhu at 44, then Likhu–Kalika–Dhunche loop at 63)** | **107** | **40** | **147** |
| Likhu twice, defer 2 elderly | 88 | 100 | 188 |

Sending car1 to help is more expensive. A dedicated trip from Benighat to Likhu and on to Dhunche takes 73 minutes, compared with 44 for car2. Routing car1 through Kalika on its way from Nilkantha adds 46 minutes and frees only one seat.

**Total cost:**
- **Driving:** 44 + 44 + 63 = 151 minutes
- **Penalties:** 2 adults × 20 = 40
- **Total:** 151 + 40 = 191
